pal.title: Command palette
pal.placeholder: Type a command, a heading, a tab or a file…
pal.help: Up and Down choose, Enter opens, Ctrl+Enter opens in a new tab, Shift+Enter in a new window, Esc closes. Start with > for commands only, # for headings only.
pal.foot: <kbd>↑</kbd><kbd>↓</kbd> choose · <kbd>Enter</kbd> open · <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd> new tab · <kbd>></kbd> commands · <kbd>#</kbd> headings
cmd.kwReading: font size spacing width theme language
start.tagline: A quiet Markdown viewer, native on Linux.
msg.loadingDetail: Reading the file on a background job.
msg.deletedDetail: The file was deleted. The buffer is kept in memory.
msg.openFailedCard: This file could not be opened.
msg.sourcePreviewTruncated: Showing the first {drawn} of {total} lines. This file is over the reader's size cap; the source preview shows the beginning.
editor.previewDetail: The Markdown is parsed on a background job.
editor.notAvailableDetail: The editor session is not available.
prompt.discardBody: You have unsaved changes. Save them before returning to reading, discard them, or cancel.
prompt.closeTabBody: {name} has unsaved changes. Save them before closing, or discard them?
prompt.quitBody: These documents have unsaved changes: {names}. Save them before quitting?
prompt.saveConflictBody: The file changed on disk since it was read. Overwrite it with your version, or keep the version on disk?
prompt.taskConflictBody: The file changed on disk before the task change could be saved. Overwrite it, or keep the version on disk?
prompt.deletedBody: The file was deleted while it was open. Save again recreates it; cancel keeps the buffer in memory.
prompt.diskChangedBody: The file changed on disk. Reload it and lose your unsaved changes, or keep editing yours?
prompt.draftBody: A recovery draft from {at} differs from the file. Restore it into the editor? The file stays unchanged until you save.
prompt.leaseBody: Window {n} is already editing this document. Close that editor before editing here.
set.title: Settings
set.sizeDetail: Eight steps from 13 to 22 points, as the original app.
set.widthDetail: Narrow 640, normal 760, wide 920; full fills the pane.
set.panelsDetail: Text size in the file browser and the outline.
set.largeFileDetail: Chosen when editing starts: Auto switches to block mode above 64 KiB or 1,500 lines.
set.formatBarDetail: Show the formatting buttons above the source while editing.
set.spellcheckDetail: Underlines misspelled words with the {dictionary} dictionary.
set.spellcheckFallback: Using the {dictionary} dictionary because no dictionary matches the interface language.
set.restoreDetail: Reopen the windows and tabs from the last session at startup.
set.breakH1Detail: Print and PDF start a new page at each H1; the Share menu reads the same option.
set.languageDetail: Auto follows the system language; a change applies at once.
set.resetQuestion: Reset every setting, including the theme and language? The page break option is kept.
set.defaultMd: Make lmdv the default for Markdown files
set.defaultMdDetail: Registers lmdv with Windows, which then asks you to confirm in Default apps.
set.defaultMdDetailLinux: Sets lmdv as the default app for Markdown files in your desktop.
table.noTarget: Open a table from its action bar first.
table.noRows: This table has no rows to show.
table.nothingToCopy: This table has nothing to copy.
task.notReady: The document is still being parsed; the task was not changed.
task.saving: A task change is still being saved.
task.ambiguous: That task item could not be located unambiguously, so nothing was written.
task.changedOnDisk: That task item changed on disk; nothing was written.
task.changedWhileClicked: That task item changed while it was clicked; nothing was written.
task.bufferChanged: The task changed in the buffer. Save the document to keep it.
task.bufferUndone: Undid the task in the buffer. Save the document to keep it.
task.moved: The document moved; the task was not overwritten.
task.changedAgain: The task changed again; nothing was written.
